title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2610.12229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine

translated_title: VibeEdit：基于画布指令的图像编辑
translated_abstract: 在文本引导的图像编辑中，描述所需的更改通常很简单，但识别目标对象或区域可能很麻烦，尤其是当多个对象看起来相似时。我们引入了一种新的图像编辑界面，允许用户直接在图像上放置空间标记和可选的简短注释。这些标注共同构成一个“画布指令”，用于指定在哪里编辑以及更改什么内容。我们的编辑器 VibeEdit 遵循这些指令，无需单独的文本提示即可执行对象添加、删除、替换、属性修改和移动等操作。我们构建了155万个带有对象掩码和结构化编辑描述的源-目标编辑对，并在训练过程中从中渲染画布指令。我们采用层解耦条件化技术对 Qwen-Image-Edit 进行适配，将源图像和画布指令分开编码以用于图像编辑。我们使用区域加权监督微调来训练模型……
tldr: VibeEdit 提出了一种全新的图像编辑交互方式，用户可直接在图像上放置空间标记和简短注释形成“画布指令”，模型据此无需文本提示即可完成对象添加、删除、替换、属性修改和移动等编辑操作，并通过155万编辑对数据和层解耦条件化技术适配 Qwen-Image-Edit。
en_tdlr: VibeEdit introduces a novel image editing interface where users place spatial marks and short notes directly on the image to form "canvas instructions," enabling the model to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without separate text prompts, supported by 1.55 million edit pairs and layer-decoupled conditioning adapted to Qwen-Image-Edit.
